## Services

### The Last Bedliner Your Truck Will Ever Need
URL: https://www.capitalupfitters.com/services/bedliner.html
Starting from: 575

Authorized Patriot Liner dealer. Premium polyurea formula — heated to 155°F, 2,000 PSI. Dry in under 10 seconds. Lifetime warranty.

## BUILT TO TAKE A BEATING.

Not all spray liners are the same. The chemistry, application temperature, and pressure make all the difference. Here's why Patriot Liner leads the field.

Every Patriot Liner installation comes with a lifetime manufacturer warranty. If it peels, fades, or cracks, we make it right — no questions asked.

Our heated, high-pressure application bonds the polyurea directly to the metal. It doesn't sit on top of your bed — it becomes part of it. Zero risk of delamination.

Patriot Liner is an American-made product developed and backed by veterans. You're not just protecting your truck — you're supporting a company built on integrity.

## PATRIOT LINER GOES ANYWHERE.

Polyurea spray coating bonds to almost any surface — metal, wood, concrete, fiberglass. If it needs protection, grip, or waterproofing, we can coat it.

Utility trailers, enclosed cargo trailers, flatbeds, horse trailers, boat trailers. Full waterproofing, rust protection, and non-slip grip.

Non-slip textured coating on truck steps, running boards, dock steps, industrial platforms. Grip that stays grippy even when wet.

Gunwales, decks, dock boards, pontoon floors. Polyurea is 100% waterproof and UV-stable — built for constant exposure to sun and water.

## PRICING BY BED SIZE.

No hidden fees. No surprises. Every quote includes full bed prep, professional application, and lifetime warranty registration.

Enhanced UV stabilizer formula for vehicles kept outdoors. Prevents color fade and chalking over time.

## FROM DROP-OFF TO PICKUP.

A clean, professional process every time. Your truck is treated with care from the moment it arrives.

We inspect the bed for rust, damage, or accessories that need to be removed prior to application.

The bed is cleaned, sanded, and masked. Proper prep ensures maximum adhesion and a clean edge line.

Patriot Liner is applied at 155°F, 2,000 PSI. Dries in under 10 seconds for a seamless, permanent bond.

### Tonneau Covers For Every Truck And Budget
URL: https://www.capitalupfitters.com/services/tonneau.html
Starting from: 300

Folding, roll-up, retractable, and hard panel covers. 150+ brands. Professional installation — no drilling, factory fit. Starting from $300.

## SECURE, SLEEK, AND SMARTER.

A tonneau cover isn't just cosmetic. It secures your gear, protects your cargo from weather, and actually improves your truck's fuel economy at highway speeds.

BAKFlip, Retrax, TruXedo, Extang, Roll-N-Lock, Access, Lund — we carry the brands that hold up. We'll match you to the right cover for how you use your truck.

Every cover we install uses the factory stake holes or bed rail clamps — zero drilling, no damage to your truck. Clean install, clean look, and no impact on resale value.

An open truck bed creates significant drag at highway speeds. A tonneau cover reduces that drag and has been shown to improve fuel economy by 2–5% in real-world conditions.

## THE COVERS WE CARRY.

We carry the top brands — from entry-level soft roll-up to premium aluminum retractable. Every cover professionally installed, factory fit, no drilling on most trucks.

Our most popular combo: the Patriot BC-1 hard aluminum tonneau paired with a Patriot Liner spray-on bedliner. Same appointment, same-day completion. Full bed protection — top and bottom — from one shop with one warranty.

Our in-house brand. Ultra-thick aluminum panels — up to 4× thicker than standard covers. DiamondSHIELD matte finish resists scratches and corrosion. EPDM seals stop water before it enters. Supports 400 lbs. Flips up for 100% bed access.

The best-selling hard folding cover in the US. Gen 3 MX4 features polymer-reinforced aluminum panels 22% stronger than the original, auto-latch locking on every panel, and improved perimeter seals. Assembled in Missouri. 5-year warranty.

## NO DRILLING. PERFECT FIT.

We match you to the right cover for your use case and budget from our inventory of 150+ brands.

### Ceramic Coating That Actually Lasts
URL: https://www.capitalupfitters.com/services/ceramic-coating.html
Starting from: 400

IGL Coatings and System X certified installer. Professional-grade hydrophobic protection — not the spray-on stuff from the auto parts store. Prices from $900.

## PROTECTION THAT'S ACTUALLY PERMANENT.

The difference between a $20 spray and a professional ceramic coating is the difference between a bandage and surgery. One actually solves the problem.

We're certified by two of the world's leading ceramic coating brands. That means proper prep, correct product selection, and a warranty you can actually use.

Water beads and rolls off your paint instantly. Road grime, bird droppings, and tree sap can't chemically bond to a properly coated surface. Your paint stays cleaner, longer.

The nano-ceramic layer's high surface tension means rain water picks up loose dirt on the way down. Less washing, less swirling, less effort maintaining your paint.

## PROTECTION FOR EVERY BUDGET.

Ceramic coating pricing depends on vehicle size, paint condition, and coverage level. These are starting prices — contact us for an exact quote after vehicle inspection.

## PREP IS EVERYTHING.

A ceramic coating is only as good as the prep work beneath it. We don't skip steps — and we don't coat over problems.

We inspect the paint under professional lighting for swirls, contamination, and oxidation to determine what prep is required.

Wash, clay bar, iron decontamination. Paint correction if needed. The surface must be perfect before any coating goes on.

Applied panel by panel in a controlled environment. Each layer is leveled and inspected before moving to the next panel.

## CERTIFIED CERAMIC COATING IN ROCKVILLE & BETHESDA.

Car owners across Bethesda, Rockville, Potomac, and North Bethesda choose Capital Upfitters for IGL and System X ceramic coating — because proper paint protection starts with proper prep. We're one of the few certified installers in Montgomery County. Located at 12019 Nebel St in Rockville, easily accessible from I-270 and Route 355.

### Stop Rust Before It Starts
URL: https://www.capitalupfitters.com/services/undercoating.html
Starting from: 650

Professional undercoating for all vehicles. Maryland road salt destroys unprotected metal. Rubberized and oil-based options. Prices from $650.

## MARYLAND ROADS EAT METAL.

The DMV gets heavy salt treatment every winter. That salt works into every seam, every crevice, every surface your vehicle touches the road with. Undercoating is the only reliable defense.

Road salt accelerates corrosion dramatically. Our undercoating creates a sealed barrier between your vehicle's metal and the caustic salt and moisture that come with every winter.

Rubberized undercoating bonds to metal and cures into a thick, flexible shield that doesn't crack, peel, or wash away. Applied right, it lasts the life of the vehicle.

A welcome side effect: rubberized undercoating acts as a sound damper. Many customers notice a noticeably quieter ride after undercoating — especially on highway surfaces.

## STRAIGHTFORWARD PRICING.

Priced by vehicle class. New vehicles quoted below. Used vehicles may require additional prep work — we'll let you know before starting.

## THOROUGH EVERY TIME.

We put the vehicle on a lift and inspect for existing rust, damage, and any areas needing special attention before treatment.

The undercarriage is cleaned and dried. Rust neutralizer is applied where needed. Exhaust and moving parts are masked off.

Rubberized or oil-based undercoat is applied with professional equipment for full, even coverage — including frame rails and body seams.

The coating sets quickly. Most vehicles are ready same-day. We do a final inspection before you take it home.

## PROTECTING DMV VEHICLES FROM MARYLAND SALT.

Maryland roads are salted heavily every winter — and that salt works into every seam, every frame rail, every exposed metal surface on your vehicle. Drivers from Rockville, Silver Spring, Gaithersburg, and Bethesda bring their trucks, SUVs, and cars to us before the first freeze for full undercarriage protection. We're at 12019 Nebel St in Rockville, minutes from I-270.

### Window Tinting Done Right
URL: https://www.capitalupfitters.com/services/window-tinting.html

Heat rejection, UV protection, and privacy — installed with precision-cut film and zero bubbles. We tint cars, trucks, SUVs, and vans at our Rockville MD shop.

## MARYLAND TINT LAW.

Maryland has specific VLT requirements for each window position. We check every install before you leave.

Reflectivity rule: No more than 35% reflective on any window. We do not install high-reflective metallic films. | VLT explained: VLT = Visible Light Transmission. 35% VLT means the window lets in 35% of visible light — darker film, lower number. 70% VLT is nearly clear.

## WHY TINT YOUR WINDOWS?

The right film does far more than darken glass. Here's what quality window tinting delivers for Maryland drivers.

Quality tint film blocks up to 60% of solar heat in Maryland summers. Your AC works less, your interior stays cooler, and leather seats don't burn you.

UV rays damage dashboards, fade upholstery, and accelerate leather cracking. Ceramic film blocks 99% of UV — protecting both your interior and passengers.

Tinted windows deter smash-and-grab theft by obscuring interior contents. Privacy matters whether you're parked at a Rockville parking garage or a Bethesda trail head.

## CHOOSE YOUR FILM.

Four levels of protection — from budget-friendly dyed film to maximum-performance ceramic. All Maryland legal.

Dyed polyester film — reduces glare and provides privacy. Good for budget-conscious owners who want basic protection. Does not reject significant heat. May fade slightly over time.

Carbon film has a matte finish that doesn't fade or turn purple over time. Superior heat rejection vs. dyed film, no signal interference with electronics. A significant step up in both performance and appearance.

Ceramic film uses nano-ceramic particles instead of dye or carbon — giving you maximum heat rejection without any signal interference. The clearest-looking tint available, virtually color-neutral. The only film that blocks 99% UV and up to 60% heat simultaneously.

## MAXIMUM PROTECTION.

Pair ceramic window tint with ceramic paint coating for the ultimate interior and exterior protection combo.

The ultimate exterior protection combo. Ceramic window tint (99% UV rejection, 60% heat rejection) paired with an IGL or System X ceramic coating on the paint. Scheduled same week — both installs done at our Rockville shop.

## TRANSPARENT RATE STRUCTURE.

Hitch pricing depends on the vehicle and the product. Below is our rate structure. Contact us for a vehicle-specific quote — we'll have an answer fast.

## BEYOND THE STANDARD HITCH.

Class V hitches, 5th wheel preps, gooseneck conversions, brake controllers, and weight distribution systems. We handle the full towing setup — not just the ball mount.

Fifth wheel hitch installation for towing large RVs and horse trailers. We handle kingpin prep, bed liner protection, and wiring integration. Compatible with B\&W, Reese, and Curt 5th wheel systems.

Gooseneck ball and safety chain installation for heavy-duty towing of flatbed trailers, equipment haulers, and livestock trailers. Retractable systems keep your bed usable when not towing.

Electric trailer brake controller installation — required by Maryland law for trailers over 3,000 lbs with electric brakes. Proportional controllers modulate trailer braking in sync with your truck. We install and calibrate on-site.

### Lift Kits & Leveling Kits
URL: https://www.capitalupfitters.com/services/suspension.html

Raise your stance, fit larger tires, and improve off-road capability. We install leveling kits, lift kits, and suspension upgrades for trucks and SUVs across the DMV.

## WHY LIFT YOUR TRUCK OR SUV?

A leveling kit or lift kit does more than change how your truck looks. Here's what you actually gain.

More lift = more tire clearance. Fit 33s, 35s, or larger without rubbing. Most leveling kits allow one tire size up. Full lift kits open up much more.

Higher ground clearance means you can tackle Maryland's back roads, trails, and uneven terrain without scraping your undercarriage.

A level or lifted truck just looks better. Remove the factory nose-down rake and give your truck the aggressive stance it deserves.

## SUSPENSION OPTIONS WE OFFER.

From simple leveling kits to full suspension builds — we install the right kit for your goals and budget.

Leveling kits correct the factory front-to-rear rake on most trucks — raising the front end 1.5″–3″ to match the rear. Most trucks sit lower in the front from the factory for improved aerodynamics. Leveling kits eliminate this, improve appearance, and allow slightly larger tires.

Entry to mid-level lift kits. Coilover spacers or strut extensions paired with rear blocks or add-a-leaf kits. Allows 33″ tires on most full-size trucks. Maintains factory ride quality on most builds.

Full suspension lift kits with replacement control arms, new coilovers, and extended brake lines. Allows up to 37″ tires on properly built trucks. Requires alignment after install. Best for serious off-road builds.

## FROM QUOTE TO LIFTED.

Four steps from initial conversation to driving off with your new stance.

Bigger tires? Better clearance? Pure appearance? We spec the right lift for your goals and budget.

Vehicle-specific parts ordered for your exact year, make, model, and trim.

Full suspension install. Alignment completed before you drive off.

## LIFT KITS INSTALLED ACROSS THE DMV.

Truck and SUV owners from Rockville, Gaithersburg, Bethesda, and Silver Spring bring their rigs to Capital Upfitters for leveling kits and lift kit installs. We're at 12019 Nebel St in Rockville, minutes from I-270. Most installs completed same-week.

### Led Light Bars & Work Lights
URL: https://www.capitalupfitters.com/services/lighting.html

See further. Work safer. Stand out. RIGID Industries and premium LED lighting for trucks, fleets, and commercial vehicles — professionally installed with integrated wiring.

## WHY UPGRADE TO LED LIGHTING?

Factory lighting wasn't built for job sites, off-road trails, or long rural drives after dark. Here's what a quality LED upgrade changes.

LED light bars throw 10–20× more usable light than factory fog lights. Essential for rural driving, construction sites, and off-road use after dark.

Work lights mounted on trucks, vans, and equipment let your crew work safely after dark. Required on many commercial job sites and government contracts.

Quality LED lights last 50,000+ hours with minimal power draw. No bulbs to replace. No heat damage to housings.

## LIGHTING SYSTEMS WE INSTALL.

From single off-road light bars to full fleet lighting packages — we spec, supply, mount, and wire it all.

Single-row and dual-row LED light bars for off-road use, rural driving, and brush clearing. Roof mounts, bumper mounts, and grille mounts available. RIGID Industries D-Series and E-Series are the industry standard.

Scene lights, cargo lights, and underbody work lights for commercial vans, utility trucks, and service vehicles. Popular with HVAC, electrical, and emergency service fleets across the DMV. We install and wire to factory switch panels or custom switches.

### Industrial & Protective Coating Solutions
URL: https://www.capitalupfitters.com/services/industrial-coatings.html

Polyurea, epoxy, aliphatic, and aromatic protective coatings for commercial vehicles, government fleets, school buses, emergency equipment, civil infrastructure, industrial equipment, and facilities. Mobile application available — we come to your site.

## PROTECTION FOR EVERY SURFACE.

From a single cargo van floor to a full municipal fleet — we apply the right coating system for your surface, environment, and performance requirement.

Spray-applied high-elongation polyurea coatings that absorb and dissipate blast energy across vehicle panels, facility walls, and structural surfaces. Used by military, law enforcement, and government facilities requiring enhanced structural resilience.

Seamless, pinhole-free barrier coatings that seal metal surfaces against moisture, salt, and chemical exposure. Ideal for commercial vehicle undercarriages, cargo trailers, utility equipment, and industrial steel structures in the DMV's harsh seasonal environment.

OSHA and ADA-compliant textured coatings for vehicle cargo floors, dock ramps, industrial walkways, stairs, and platforms. Maintains grip in wet, oily, or high-traffic conditions without sacrificing durability.

## THE RIGHT CHEMISTRY FOR THE JOB.

Not every surface needs the same coating. We select the correct chemistry based on your surface type, environment, load requirements, and performance specifications.

Pure spray-applied polyurea delivers 100% solids, zero VOC, and cure times measured in seconds. Exceptional tensile strength and elongation — ideal for surfaces requiring impact resistance, waterproofing, and chemical resistance in demanding environments.

Aliphatic formulations are engineered for exterior surfaces where UV exposure would degrade standard coatings. Color-stable and gloss-retaining long after aromatic systems would fade — the correct choice for any surface exposed to direct sunlight.

Aromatic polyurea provides the highest mechanical performance — tensile strength, elongation, and abrasion resistance — at the most cost-effective price point. Typically used as the primary protective layer under an aliphatic topcoat on exterior applications.

## WHO WE SERVE.

From commercial fleets and government agencies to school buses, emergency equipment, civil infrastructure, and industrial operations — we apply the right coating system for every surface and environment.

Contractors, utilities, HVAC, electrical, and delivery operators. Mobile coating at your yard — cargo floors, truck beds, van interiors, and undercarriages.

State, county, and local government vehicles and facilities. DOT-compliant application, documentation provided, eligible for GSA procurement and state contract vehicles.

Trailers, cargo vans, rail equipment, and heavy transport assets. Standardized coating specs applied across entire fleets for consistent protection.

## HOW IT WORKS.

A systematic approach from first contact to final coat. Every job documented and done to spec.

We evaluate your surfaces, environment, load requirements, and performance specs. In-shop or on-site assessment depending on scale.

We specify the correct chemistry (polyurea, aliphatic, aromatic, epoxy) and application method for your surface and conditions.

Proper prep is everything. We clean, abrade, and prime surfaces to ensure maximum adhesion and coating longevity.
